training_reactions: same 256 reaction IDs and anchor frames as v0.3; complete source histories across all 13 shards
selection: validation sampled-barrier MAE; tie-break TS-region force RMSE; all runs must finish before selection
holdouts: endpoint-only manifests are frozen before training; no holdout reference energies, forces or evaluation are opened by the screening runner
phase_after_screening: freeze optimizer/replay comparisons using validation, repeat promising settings at 3 seeds, then freeze models and decision-layer policies before opening prospective evaluation
compute_comparison: random4096 and path4096 have equal reaction/configuration/epoch ceilings; actual updates, early stopping and wall time are reported. Different-size arms are not equal-compute experiments.
meta_study: TabPFN/TabICL on unused train reactions only; grouped validation, no legacy test reaction labels for fitting. Jev-style local decisions are an exploratory comparator.
expert_routing: first quantify the unattainable per-reaction reference oracle headroom; fit endpoint-feature-only expert selection with reaction/formula grouped out-of-fold predictions; compare best fixed expert and charge routing cost. Freeze one expert for the full NEB/IRC chain. No image-by-image switching or claims of a globally smooth mixed PES.
